ballPolicy: The separate basketball is carried at the beginning, drops low and forward as Moxie falls, and remains on court while she rises. Never drawn in the sprite.
cleanupNotes: Generated sheet had a purple painted backdrop. Applied the documented local RGB-contrast matte (Gaussian sigma 38px, alpha fade for contrast 21–42); raw source retained separately.

review.reviewNotes: Ten complete sequential Moxie figures in a five-by-two sheet with clear cell margins. Adult human identity, pale skin, lavender eyes, high ponytail/gold tie, purple/silver uniform and shoes stay consistent. Controlled fall sequence progresses from stumble to side fall, seated, kneeling and standing recovery, without injury. Background cleanup checked on light background; no ball drawn.
